loci.label: Trinity
loci.description: Bounded propositions concerning the one God and the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

loci.label: Christology
loci.description: Bounded propositions concerning the person, natures, offices, and work of Christ.

loci.label: Covenant
loci.description: Bounded propositions concerning divine covenants and their theological functions.

loci.label: Justification
loci.description: Bounded propositions concerning the declarative saving act and its ground and instrument.

loci.label: Sacraments
loci.description: Bounded propositions concerning baptism, the supper, and sacramental signs and seals.

loci.label: Law
loci.description: Bounded propositions concerning divine law, its uses, scope, and relation to the gospel.

loci.label: Providence
loci.description: Bounded propositions concerning divine preservation, concurrence, and government.

loci.label: Ecclesiology
loci.description: Bounded propositions concerning the church, its marks, order, authority, and communion.
